objective: Diagnose conditional classification damage from existing feature approximations, then run a small matched representation probe only if justified.

data.historical_test_use: NONE: do not select or evaluate new candidates on historical test
data.fusion: Historical K7 unchanged; no new time limit or pose alignment

resources.location: local CPU; server read-only health probe only

interpretation: Slot replacement is a diagnostic counterfactual, not a costed synthesizable hardware proposal. Prediction disagreement alone is not damage.

training_gate.candidate_rule: Among eligible modes meeting both exploratory gates, choose highest validation macro-F1; fixed listed order breaks exact ties.
training_gate.if_none_pass: Stop at diagnosis and document negative result; no training sweep

training.loss: class-weighted cross entropy; weights from selected train only
training.normalization: per-feature train-only standardization of frozen int8 feature representations
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch, no best-val checkpoint or hyperparameter sweep
training.precision_scope: FP32 weights and activations with already-int8 input representations; NOT deployed QAT or bit-exact integer model
training.purpose: Check whether a fixed-old-model benefit survives matched retraining. No deployment accuracy or hardware savings claim.

groups.boundary: at power-of-two / just above power-of-two / other
groups.uncertainty: paired whole-sequence bootstrap, 2000 replicates, fixed seed 20260916; correlated windows not treated as independent

review.type: single-executor pre-run audit, not independent review
checks: Hard process timeouts and phase gates
